entities.name: Numbered Ones
entities.description: The most powerful wizards of the Kingdom of Khone, given numbers instead of names.

entities.name: Kingdom of Khone
entities.description: Kingdom whose Khonians gathered promising spellcasters.

entities.name: Khone Valley of Sacrifice
entities.description: Valley where promising spellcasters were forced to survive using magic.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar the Swamp King
entities.description: Ruler to whom the strongest wizards were sent on the Date of Tribute.

entities.name: Gydolien Mor
entities.description: The only one of the Numbered Ones to survive the Yalomar Cat explosion.

entities.name: Yalomar Cat
entities.description: Creature whose explosion killed the Numbered Ones except Gydolien Mor.

entities.name: Khonian midwives
entities.description: Khonians who domineered the young wizards.

events.summary: The Khonians gather promising spellcasters in the Valley of Sacrifice and force them to survive with magic.
events.quote: The Khonians gathered all promising spellcasters into the Khone Valley of Sacrifice and forced them to survive using magic.

events.summary: A Yalomar Cat explosion blinds the Numbered Ones and kills all but Gydolien Mor.
events.quote: They were blinded when the explosion of a Yalomar Cat killed all the Numbered Ones except the one named Gydolien Mor .

relations.note: The strongest were sent to him on the Date of Tribute.
relations.quote: The strongest were sent to Sol'Kanar the Swamp King on the Date of Tribute .
